options.name: abe
options.description: Enable Access Based Share Enumeration.

options.name: acl
options.description: When set, enables ACL support for the share.

options.name: apple_encoding
options.description: Use Apple-style character encoding. By default, Samba uses a hashing algorithm for filename characters that are illegal in NTFS. This option causes it to translate such characters to the Unicode private range.

options.name: auxsmbconf
options.description: Additional smb4.conf options.

options.name: browsable
options.description: If true, share is visible when browsing shares.

options.name: comment
options.description: Description of the share, for the system maintainer.

options.name: durablehandle
options.description: Enables using file handles that can withstand short disconnections. Enables support for POSIX byte-range locks.

options.name: enabled
options.description: If true, the share is enabled. Otherwise, it is present but disabled.

options.name: fsrvp
options.description: Enable File Server Remote VSS Protocol (FSRVP). This allows RPC clients to manage snapshots for the share.

options.name: guestok
options.description: Enables guest access (no login).

options.name: home
options.description: If true, this share may be used for home directories. Only one such share is allowed.

options.name: hostsallow
options.description: List of hostnames/IP addresses of hosts that are allowed access to the share. If C(hostsallow) and C(hostsdeny) conflict, C(hostsallow) takes precedence.

options.name: hostsdeny
options.description: List of hostnames/IP addresses of hosts that are denied access to the share. If C(hostsallow) and C(hostsdeny) conflict, C(hostsallow) takes precedence.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the share, as seen by the SMB client.

options.name: path
options.description: Directory to share, on the server.

options.name: path_suffix
options.description: Suffix appended to the share connection path. This may contain macros, as defined in smb.conf(5).

options.name: purpose
options.description:
Specifies a family of configuration parameters for different use
cases. Legal values include:
 C(NO_PRESET), C(DEFAULT_SHARE), C(ENHANCED_TIMEMACHINE), C(MULTI_PROTOCOL_APP), C(MULTI_PROTOCOL_NFS), C(PRIVATE_DATASETS), C(WORM_DROPBOX). Note that the C(purpose) parameter may override other parameters. In particular, C(DEFAULT_SHARE) specifies an empty C(hostsallow) and C(hostsdeny). Under SCALE 25.10, C(NO_PRESET) has been dropped, so this module silently replaces it with C(DEFAULT_SHARE).

options.name: recyclebin
options.description:
If true, enables Windows Recycle Bin: deleted files are moved to the
Recycle Bin. If false, deleted files are immediately deleted.

options.name: ro
options.description: If true, share is read-only.

options.name: shadowcopy
options.description: When set, export ZFS snapshots as VSS shadow copies.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the share should exist or not.

options.name: streams
options.description: Allow multiple NTFS data streams.

options.name: timemachine
options.description: Enables support for Apple Time Machine backups.
